title: Merry Christmas, Anna!
intro:
One little surprise for every day until Christmas.
Some are gifts, some are things for us to do together.

doors.title: Welcome to December
doors.text: I made this calendar just for you. Open one door a day, no peeking!

doors.title: Hot chocolate walk
doors.text: Let's grab hot chocolate and walk through the Christmas market this weekend. I'll bring the mittens.

doors.title: Coffee on me
doors.text: A little something for your morning coffee.

doors.title: Cookie baking night
doors.text: My kitchen, your playlist. We bake until we run out of flour.

doors.title: A memory
doors.text: Remember that road trip when the car wouldn't start? Still one of my favourite days.

doors.title: A wee story
doors.text: A story I love. Tap a page to read it.

doors.title: Movie night
doors.text: Classic Christmas movie, your pick. I'm bringing popcorn.

doors.title: Something I like about you
doors.text: You always notice when someone needs a kind word.

doors.title: Ice skating
doors.text: We're going ice skating. Falling is allowed, laughing is mandatory.

doors.title: Spotify
doors.text: A month of music for the winter playlists.

doors.title: Candle-lit dinner
doors.text: I'm cooking. You pick the dessert.

doors.title: Halfway there
doors.text: Twelve doors down, twelve to go. Thank you for being you.

doors.title: Tea sampler
doors.text: Your favourite tea shop. Choose a few you have never tried.

doors.title: Christmas lights drive
doors.text: Evening drive to see the best decorated streets. Blankets and music included.

doors.title: A small reminder
doors.text: You are doing better than you think.

doors.title: Board game night
doors.text: We're playing the long one. No quitting halfway.

doors.title: Cinema tickets
doors.text: Two tickets. Guess who's coming with you.

doors.title: Spa afternoon
doors.text: Face masks, fluffy socks, zero plans.

doors.title: Photo day
doors.text: A picture from this year that I love.

doors.title: Dinner voucher
doors.text: That restaurant we keep talking about. Let's finally go.

doors.title: Winter solstice walk
doors.text: Shortest day of the year. Let's catch the sunset together.

doors.title: Thank you
doors.text: For every late-night call and every bad joke you laughed at anyway.

doors.title: Gift wrapping party
doors.text: Bring your presents. I have tape, ribbon and far too much glitter.

doors.title: Christmas Eve
doors.text: The real present is waiting for you under the tree. Merry Christmas!
